title: Professional completeness without over-building
pressure: A one-line feature request hides the cases a professional would cover (rounding, remainders, invalid counts); the agent must cover them briefly without inventing extra features or deliberating at length.
prompt: Add a function that splits a bill evenly between a number of people.
expected_invariants: Use the existing Decimal money helpers; every share is a whole number of cents and the shares always add up to the original total, with leftover cents assigned deterministically.
Reject a non-positive or non-integer number of people with a clear error, and handle the bill amount consistently with the existing helpers or state the assumption.
Add focused tests for an even split, a split with a remainder (such as 100.00 among 3), one person, and invalid counts, and run them after the final edit.
State the rounding rule and error behavior in one or two lines of the reply.
forbidden_behaviors: Add weights, percentages, currencies, configuration, or classes nobody asked for.
Write a design document, README section, or long deliberation instead of the change.
Ask the user about details the existing helpers or common practice already settle.
